_doc: Cosmetics the Cannery hands out (ids in profile unlocks.cosmetics). 'slot' groups what the Locker equips together (one per slot); slot 'collection' is shown on the shelf by your locker, 'pack' at Barnaby's desk, 'arena_variant' as an arena look. None of these change gameplay. View data (docs/HUB_SYSTEMS.md §16): 'attach' = a mesh riding your fighter (kind tooth|lid|belt|scarf; CosmeticAttachments), 'juice' = a JUICE colour variant for one creature, 'frame' = the border of your name card (fight HUD, results, profile), 'color' = a collectible's label colour.

items.name: Gold Tooth
items.desc: Granny's old gold tooth in your fighter's grin. When the gag piece pops off at the end of a fight, the gold tooth is what flies.

items.name: Trash-Can Lid Shield
items.desc: Strapped to your arm like a shield (slung on the back if you have no arms) in the Cannery and on the walkout.

items.name: Replica Belt
items.desc: Worn over the shoulder in the Cannery and on the walkout. The real one is at the cleaners.

items.name: Vintage Bellows line pack
items.desc: Barnaby, 1973 edition: more hair, more reverb. Turn it on at Barnaby's desk for your matches.

items.name: Sign Fixer frame
items.desc: Your name card in full GLANDCO neon.

items.name: Soaked frame
items.desc: Your name card after a 50-bucket drill streak. Smells like it.

items.name: Sizzle
items.desc: Stoke only: his furnace and his JUICE burn white-hot.

items.name: Frozen Blister
items.desc: A Blister on ice. Follows you around the Cannery. Mostly sliding.

items.name: Rooftop Scarf
items.desc: Found in an old trunk on the roof. Worn around the neck everywhere you fight. Smells like pigeons and victory.

items.name: Barnacled Electrolyte Gum
items.desc: OTC supplement variant: pulled from the harbor, still sealed. Probably. On the shelf by your locker.

items.name: Brackish Tonic
items.desc: OTC supplement variant with a seaweed label. On the shelf by your locker.

items.name: Kelp Jerky
items.desc: OTC supplement variant. Chewy. Wet. Iconic. On the shelf by your locker.

items.name: Rusty Liniment
items.desc: OTC supplement variant in a tin that has seen things. On the shelf by your locker.

items.name: Salt-Crust Lozenges
items.desc: OTC supplement variant. The crust is the flavour. On the shelf by your locker.

items.name: Low-Tide Protein Shake
items.desc: OTC supplement variant. Shaken by the harbor itself. On the shelf by your locker.

items.name: Pier Night (Chum Rush arena variant)
items.desc: Chum Rush's hidden arena look: the Drydock as the pier under the dock, after dark.

items.name: Rooftop: full neon
items.desc: The Rooftop's night with every GLANDCO letter lit.
